acceptance: A journey test: a predicate edit by a lane in an earlier Build does not support a later blocker claim
A TDD dispatch that legitimately adds a predicate still moves the base
fix: Design first. Decide if only a TDD dispatch may move the base.
summary: Review of the B3 design card, 2026-11-05. For a resume from an earlier phase or a re-entry to Build, the seal takes the current tree as the base. A probe: resume at Scout, a predicate edited before the resume, no snapshot, gives blocked-needs-console after 1 dispatch. verifyPredicateConflictClaim reads guard bodies from that base, so a lane edit in an earlier Build can support a later conflict claim (traced, not probed). The fresh path has this shape today.
title: A later Build entry seals the tree of that entry as the predicate base, so an earlier edit becomes the base
